title: p2025 person-to-role edge
description: The unit of this dataset. Every edge names one person, one role, the years it was held, a confidence, and the document that prints it. An edge with no source is invalid by construction.

org_id.description: The organisation the role is held at, where one applies. Empty for a chapter author with no printed affiliation.

role_type.description: mandate_author = wrote a chapter; mandate_contributor = on the contributors list; civil_society_affiliation = the organisation printed beside the contributor's name; administration = a current federal appointment.

mandate_chapter.description: The volume chapter this edge comes from, where it does.

date_from.description: Year or YYYY-MM-DD the role began, as the source states it. For volume roles, the publication year.

date_to.description: Year or YYYY-MM-DD the role ended. Empty string = still held, or not stated.

confidence.description: high = the document states it directly; medium = a primary document supports it indirectly; low = named reporting only.

source_id.description: Required. Must resolve to a row in sources.jsonl.
